title: NXP in talks to buy Ambarella for up to $5.4 billion
summary: NXP is in talks to acquire Ambarella, a chip developer, with the potential deal valued at up to $5.4 billion. The negotiations are reportedly ongoing and have been confirmed by Bloomberg News. NXP aims to expand its portfolio of automotive and industrial chips. Ambarella's technology is used in various applications, including autonomous vehicles and drones. The acquisition would strengthen NXP's position in the market. Details of the deal remain unclear.
summary_points: NXP is in talks to acquire Ambarella for up to $5.4 billion
Ambarella's technology is used in automotive and industrial applications
The potential deal has been confirmed by Bloomberg News
Details of the acquisition are still unclear
